prompts.architecture: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent isometric 2D/2.5D sprite atlas for Unity town management game Weedtopia. Make a beautiful hand-painted polished atlas of SIX distinct small Saint Mary Ville river-town buildings, exactly 3 columns and 2 rows, every object entirely inside its own equal-size cell with a broad transparent gap on every cell boundary. Consistent fixed isometric camera looking diagonally down at roofs and two walls, cream plaster, red brick, terracotta tile and petrol blue/green woodwork, soft sun from top-left, crisp detailed clean silhouettes at game scale. Top row left: FerryCourt, an old ferry ticket cottage beside a wooden dock segment with rope bollards and coiled ropes, NO boat water or background. Top row center: MaryHouse, a welcoming two-storey cream civic house with arched porch, red brick trim, open teal doors and reading benches. Top row right: LightsPavilion, a riverside evening gazebo with strings of warm paper lanterns and a small performance stage. Bottom row left: FerryWorkshop, an open-front craft shed with a boat hull being repaired, teal roof, red brick pillars and timber tools. Bottom row center: RiverClassroom, an open roofed learning deck with benches, a map board with abstract marks and small planters. Bottom row right: RiverGardenHouse, a cream conservatory cottage with brick raised beds, reeds and greenhouse windows. All structures anchored on a compact isometric base, correct ground contact and unobtrusive ambient shadows; no perspective scene, no surrounding city, no people, no text, no letters, no border, no watermarks. Actual transparent alpha background, not white, no checkerboard baked in. All six are separate standalone finished game art assets.
prompts.sign: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one transparent isometric town welcome sign sprite for Unity 2D/2.5D town game. Primary request: create a lovingly hand-painted ornate riverside town sign for Saint Mary Ville. Standalone arched cream enamel sign mounted between two sturdy dark petrol painted timber posts, subtle red brick base, tiny carved river-wave and ferry emblem above the title, climbing small white roses at each post. Lettering must read EXACTLY "Saint Mary Ville" in very clear elegant dark petrol serif letters, centered on the sign, correct spelling. Fixed isometric view, both posts and feet completely in frame, cream, red brick and petrol palette, warm sunlight upper-left, crisp clean artwork and compact ground contact, high legibility. Actual transparent alpha background and entirely isolated object; no river scene, people, other buildings, shadows outside small ground contact, frame, watermark.
prompts.residentsInitial: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: transparent full-body resident sprite atlas for polished Unity 2D town management game Weedtopia, six permanent adult neighbours of Saint Mary Ville. Exactly 3 columns and 2 rows, every adult entirely inside an equal-sized cell with broad transparent margins and absolutely no overlap, no touching on any column or row dividing lines. Order top row left Mara Bell, center Elias Reed, right Rosa Marin; bottom row left Finn Alder, center Amira Vale, right Hugo Mercer. Warm painterly high quality game illustration, realistic friendly stylized anatomy, expressive distinct faces, three-quarter standing poses, visible from entire head to shoes, soft upper-left sun, detailed clothing and objects, coherent cream, red brick and petrol town palette. Mara: dignified silver-haired woman in her sixties, warm tan skin, glasses, cream blouse and long petrol cardigan, carrying a worn town history book. Elias: sturdy older river ferry craftsman with weathered pale skin, short grey beard, blue work shirt, dark petrol apron, holding a small wooden boat model and a carpenter's mallet. Rosa: smiling middle-aged olive-skinned market cook, curly chestnut hair tied with a red scarf, cream blouse and brick-red apron, basket of fresh bread. Finn: young adult white man with freckles and ginger hair, rolled-sleeve green shirt, cream gardening apron, holding a young willow sapling in a terracotta pot. Amira: capable adult brown-skinned woman with dark curly hair pinned back, petrol mechanics jumpsuit and cream neck scarf, holding an engineering notebook and a wrench. Hugo: relaxed middle-aged Black male neighbourhood musician with salt-and-pepper hair, cream shirt and red waistcoat, carrying a violin and a warm paper lantern. All adults approachable and proud, distinct silhouettes and faces, balanced common sprite height in every cell. Actual fully transparent alpha background with no scenery and no platform. No text, captions, labels, panel borders, watermarks, no cropped limbs, no checkerboard, no extra people.
